notes.note: Fix round 4 of the delivery-state change: another window's queue-change notice only re-projects (it no longer starts a flush, and a held copy listed from another window no longer counts as a waiting row); public outbox rows carry sendUnderWay only while the claiming renderer's Web Lock is held, so the list reads Sending only then and the bubble agrees; Discard… stays mounted and the shared confirmation takes and returns focus; the composer's confirmation opens as its own popover; the phone sheet's inline actions are a group of buttons; the accepted outbox note reads in sentence case and outbox text wraps and clamps to two lines. Its only changed input is the module map's outbound dispatch Behavior paragraph (sendUnderWay, the flush hook's cross-window rule). Searched this document for outbox, outbound, flush, cross-window, Discard and message-sheet claims; none is affected. No prose change.
